proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new fields are validated, defaulted, env-overridden, stored, and synchronized across ranks during communicator init. enqueue needs review because graphUsageMode materially changes strong-stream acquire/release and graph-capture mixing behavior (including warning paths). device-topology needs review because P2P channel-per-peer/path computation is substantively changed by nChannelsPerNetPeer and maxP2pPeers-driven channel tuning.
